precipitation.uncertainty_source: IMERG V07 documented uncertainty over land at monthly to annual scales, as knowledge/datasets/imerg-v07.md records it

coverage.mean: cosine-latitude weighted over cells whose centre is inside the polygon
coverage.volume: basin-mean depth times the polygon's equal-area area from its provenance

evapotranspiration.source: MOD16A2GF 061, DOI 10.5067/MODIS/MOD16A2GF.061, tiles h10v05, h11v04, h11v05, h12v04, h12v05
evapotranspiration.uncertainty_source: MOD16 validation against flux towers and watersheds, as knowledge/datasets/mod16a2gf.md records it
evapotranspiration.open_water: cells the product marks as water (32766) are excluded from the mean: MOD16 computes no open-water evaporation, so this basin mean is land evapotranspiration and any reservoir evaporation has to be added from another source

discharge.uncertainty_source: USGS rating class good, plus or minus 5 per cent of the daily value, from the station description; a poorer class widens this and the receipt says which

storage.endpoint_note: both endpoints fall inside the mascon record; the epochs are mid-month and the offsets from the window's ends are stated in days

groundwater.method: water-table fluctuation: specific yield times the mean water-level change over the site set times the basin area; a partition of dS, not a term of the identity
groundwater.specific_yield_source: Gehman and others 2009, Water Resources Research 45(4), DOI 10.1029/2007WR006096: specific yield 0.21 plus or minus 0.03 for an unconfined alluvial aquifer in northeastern Colorado from temporal gravity surveys against measured water-level change, within the range of the site's aquifer tests (the Crossref record and abstract, read 2026-09-15); Pool and Eychaner 1995, Groundwater 33(3) 425-432, DOI 10.1111/j.1745-6584.1995.tb00299.x, measured 0.16 to 0.21 at alluvial wells by the same method (abstract read 2026-09-15). A single value for a well set spanning glacial, alluvial and bedrock aquifers is a stated assumption, not a basin property; the compilation of record, Johnson 1967, USGS Water-Supply Paper 1662-D, DOI 10.3133/wsp1662D, is cited on its registry record because its landing page was not reachable from the drafting session
groundwater.specific_yield_applies_to: unconfined wells only; the term is linear in this value and the receipt reports it at the value and at one sigma either side

groundwater.screened_interval_note: the Water Data API serves the constructed depth and the hole depth of a well and not its screened interval; the depth stated for every well here is the constructed depth from the site file

criteria: a daily mean series of parameter 72019 whose record begins on or before the window's start and ends on or after its end
the well inside the basin polygon
aquifer type code U (unconfined) in the site file, because a confined well's head change is not a storage change at specific yield
a constructed depth stated in the site file

groundwater.uncertainty_source: quadrature of the specific yield's stated uncertainty times the mean level change and the specific yield times the standard error of the site mean (the spread over sites divided by the square root of the site count); the spread itself is reported beside it, because the wells are the wells there are and not a designed sample of the basin

residual.definition: P + I - ET - Q - X - dS, so a positive residual means the terms deliver more water than the storage change accounts for
residual.sigma_definition: quadrature sum of the four term uncertainties, each from the source named beside its term

partition.fraction_note: the fraction is reported only when dS is more than two sigma from zero; a fraction of a storage change indistinguishable from zero is not a number
partition.definition: dS = dS_gw + dS_other, where dS_gw is the well set's water-table change at the stated specific yield over the basin area and dS_other is everything else the mascons see: soil moisture, snow, surface water and groundwater the wells do not sample. P + I - ET - Q - X - dS_gw equals dS_other plus the residual. The residual itself and its bar do not move: the groundwater term partitions dS, it is not a sixth term

bookkeeping: dS = dS_gw + dS_other: 1.183 = +9.752 + -8.569 km3 (dS_gw at specific yield 0.21 over 39 sites, mean rise +0.089 m with a spread of 0.846 m)
P + I - ET - Q - X - dS_gw = dS_other + residual: +61.605 = -8.569 + +70.174 km3
the residual and its consistency bar are unchanged by the groundwater term, which partitions the storage change and is not added to the identity
